thread:
maria_chen: Heads up — intake for a new model bring-up: tempest-11b (FP16 baseline + INT8 quant). Need perf onboarding: throughput/latency, ctx sweeps (4k/8k/16k), batching profiles, and a quick quant smoke. Can we prioritize this next?

dennis: Adding to the queue. What's the target SLOs and primary workload — chat or long-form completion?

maria_chen: Primary is assistant chat (2–6 turns). Median response ~120 tokens. Target SLOs: p95 latency <450ms at ~1 rps/replica for 4k ctx. Baseline expectation: 4k p95 <300ms on A100-80GB. Throughput target ~40 tok/s per GPU (ballpark).

olga: Plan: run fp16 perf suite first, then INT8 with q8_0 and q4f16 profiles. Batch sweep bs=1,2,4,8,16 and ctx=512,2048,4096,8192,16384. Capture KV cache warm vs steady state.

bench-bot: Started perf job tempest-11b/fp16 @ bench-queue-5. Job ID: b-1961002350. ETA ~45m.

kevin: Also add quality evals: 500-convo regression set + toxic-filter checks. Thresholds: if INT8 causes perplexity >+5% or BLEU/ROUGE degrade >2 points, flag.

sam: For prioritization: we have two other models in sprint. If we mark this P1 for the bring-up rotation, infra needs to reserve nodes — can we confirm owners?

leah: Assigning owners: Olga -> perf runs and artifacts, Kevin -> quality/regression checks and thresholds, Maria -> rollout decision. I'll ping infra for node reservation.

dennis: @olga can you also capture streaming-first-byte latency and token-emission curves? Need warmup traces and emission rate (tokens/sec) over time.

olga: Yep. Will include cold-start vs steady-state, prefix-caching toggles, and token-emission plots.

bench-bot: Perf job complete: b-1961002350
Summary: FP16 bs1 p95=280ms @4k ctx, bs8 aggregate throughput=380 tok/s per GPU. Raw traces uploaded -> s3://redwood-bench/tempest-11b/fp16/1961002350/

maria_chen: Great. Olga, when you kick INT8 runs, paste a reproducible checklist/commands in-thread so infra/devex can reproduce.

olga: Checklist:
1) git rev: abc1234-tempest
2) configs: `quant_profile=q8_0`, `batch_sizes=[1,2,4,8,16]`, `ctx_lens=[512,2048,4096,8192,16384]`
3) command:
```
python bench/run_perf.py --model tempest-11b --profile q8_0 \
  --batches 1,2,4,8,16 --ctx 512,2048,4096,8192,16384 \
  --out s3://redwood-bench/tempest-11b/int8/1961002351/ --seed 42
```
4) postproc: `scripts/aggregate_latency.py --jobid b-1961002351 --out /tmp/agg.json`
I'll start INT8 now.

bench-bot: Started perf job tempest-11b/int8-q8 @ bench-queue-7. Job ID: b-1961002351.

kevin: Reminder: include eval seed list, RNG seed, and store logits for a 50-sample subset for debugging. Also save model config + tokenizer version in artifact metadata.

bench-bot: Perf job b-1961002351 complete. Key results:
- INT8 q8_0 bs1 p95=360ms @4k ctx (fp16 was 280ms)
- bs8 throughput=310 tok/s per GPU
- Quality: conv-eval delta BLEU=-0.6, perplexity +4.8%
Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/tempest-11b/int8/1961002351/

maria_chen: Looks promising. Kevin, is +4.8% perplexity within our acceptable window?

kevin: Per thresholds, +4.8% < +5% so passes automated threshold. Still recommend a canary A/B to catch any subtle user-facing regressions. Also will run the toxic-filter stress tests against INT8 artifacts.

leah: I'll schedule a canary rollout: 10% traffic -> int8 variant for 24h with auto-rollback on latency/error spikes. Need infra signoff for reserved GPUs.

dennis: Ping infra: @oncall_infra can you approve 2 reserved A100s for the canary tomorrow morning?

oncall_infra: Approved. Reserving 2 A100-80GB nodes for the canary window and will wire up alerts (p95 latency, error rate, increased OOMs).

maria_chen: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source. Olga/kevin please post final artifact links, regression plots, and the canary dashboard link here when ready.
